2317-5686-7084-8345.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token
Repeat.

2226-3634-6751.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-3634-6751.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Starfield Vocalist.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Venser by paying its mana cost.
When Venser enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

950-2645-3430-6256.description:
Activate Muraganda Raceway by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping Muraganda Raceway
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Fatestitcher.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2113-3800-4687.notablePrerequisites: Iceberg has at least four counters on it.
2113-3800-4687.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn using its ability from Karametra's Favor by tapping it, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Iceberg.
Activate Iceberg as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Iceberg, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

225-4094-4365-6753-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
225-4094-4365-6753-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 4 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

1379-2685-3197-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1379-2685-3197-7743.description:
Gain life in any way.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

215-3443-7060.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven creature cards in your graveyard.
215-3443-7060.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding an amount of {B} or {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Deathbloom Ritualist from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Deathbloom Ritualist by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
215-3443-7060.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {B}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Deathbloom Ritualist

345-4050--5.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Metallic Mimic.
Repeat.

2604-4390-5078-6757-7633.easyPrerequisites: You control two other untapped artifacts.
2604-4390-5078-6757-7633.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate Meria's second ability by tapping two artifacts, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0} due to Ugin, the Ineffable.
Ravenous Robots triggers, creating a 1/1 Robot artifact creature token.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Weapons Manufacturing triggers, creating a Munitions token.
Repeat.

4556-6798-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
4556-6798-7084.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Blight Mound and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

104-1308-5086-5183-5231.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
104-1308-5086-5183-5231.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1.

4053-4336-6797-6989.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

3532-3761-5078-5645.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-3761-5078-5645.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Arcbound Crusher triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Crusher.
Repeat.

3532-5078-5402-5901.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-5402-5901.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Captain Storm.
Repeat.

2173-3652-5220-5315.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Ornithopter
When Ornithopter dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Ornithopter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Cast Ornithopter from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1778-5220-5256-6900.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Memnite
When Memnite dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Memnite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Cast Memnite from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1806-2034-2382-6867.description:
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Eternal Scourge and the Ally, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When Eternal Scourge dies, Mimic Vat triggers, exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1806-2034-2382-6867.notes: You can forego sacrificing the Ally during an iteration if mana allows.

1077-6848-6849.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to proliferate or a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Bloodcrazed Hoplite after an opponent gains control of it.
1077-6848-6849.description:
Donate control of Bloodcrazed Hoplite to an opponent.
Put a +1/+1 counter on Bloodcrazed Hoplite either by proliferating or by any other method.
Bloodcrazed Hoplite triggers, targeting any creature controlled by you or another opponent.
When the opponent commits that crime, Patrolling Peacemaker triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a +1/+1 counter on Bloodcrazed Hoplite.
Repeat from step 3.

1462-2556-6801.easyPrerequisites:
You have seven or more cards in your graveyard.
Permanents you control that enter the battlefield untapped can tap to produce at least {1}{W}{W}.
1462-2556-6801.description:
Activate any number of permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{W}{W}.
Cast Cleansing Meditation by paying {1}{W}{W}, destroying all permanents as they are all enchantments due to Enchanted Evening, and then returning all cards in your graveyard destroyed this way to the battlefield.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cleansing Meditation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1462-2556-6801.notes: You can repeat this combo as desired during your turns to continually wipe out opponents' permanents.

104-4186-4476.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-4186-4476.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

586-3168-5256-5258-5618.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {1}
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1860-2634-4036-5195.description:
Activate Emergence Zone's second ability by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it,  allowing you to cast spells as though they have flash this turn.
Cast Seething Song by paying {2}{R}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Seething Song.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Seething Song copy, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 5.

4559-4740-5670-6441.notablePrerequisites: The total mana value of noncreature artifacts you control is at least 10.
4559-4740-5670-6441.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the Treasures, returning Metalwork Colossus from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
4559-4740-5670-6441.notes: Once you have infinite life, you may activate Aetherflux Reservoir infinitely to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

2291-3489-3542.notablePrerequisites:
Coiling Stalker does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{B}{G}{U}.
2291-3489-3542.description:
Declare Coiling Stalker as an attacker.
When it isn't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{B}{G}{U}.
Activate Palinchron's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{B} and returning Coiling Stalker from the battlefield to your hand, putting Palinchron onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Coiling Stalker's ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{G} and returning Palinchron from the battlefield to your hand, putting Coiling Stalker onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{B}{G}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana.

2247-3774-4312.notablePrerequisites:
Vorel does not have summoning sickness.
Teferi has at least six loyalty counters on it.
Luxior attached to Teferi.
2247-3774-4312.description:
Activate Vorel by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of loyalty counters on Teferi.
Activate Teferi's third loyalty ability by removing ten loyalty counters from it, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your first extra turn.
Activate Teferi's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to loot.
Activate Vorel by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of loyalty counters on Teferi.
Move to your second extra turn.
Repeat.

864-2281-4050-4191.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Eternal Witness.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness, adding one mana of any color.
When Eternal Witness dies, Saffi triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Saffi by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Repeat.

1651-3888-4306.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to red is at least seven.
1651-3888-4306.description:
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {5}{R}{R}.
Activate Olivia's Attendants by paying {2}{R}, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Olivia's Attendants triggers, creating a Blood token.
Repeat from step 2 one additional time.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Blood tokens, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Repeat.

391-757-4235.notablePrerequisites: Blossom Dryad does not have summoning sickness.
391-757-4235.description:
Activate Magosi's second activated ability by tapping it and paying {U}.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers; choose not to pay for it.
Resolve the Magosi ability, putting an eon counter on Magosi and skipping your next turn.
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it targeting Magosi.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers; choose not to pay for it.
Activate Magosi's third activated ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it, and returning it to your hand.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers; pay {2} and copy the Magosi ability.
Resolve both copies of the ability, cancelling out your skipped turn and taking an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
Repeat each turn.

628-2292-2890-3693-4892.description:
Cast Flash, choosing Protean Hulk.
Let Hulk die in Flash resolution.
Pull Walking Ballista and Mikaeus, the Unhallowed on Hulk death trigger.
Sacrifice Ballista tosacrificeoutlet, it returns with a +1/+1 counter from Mikaeus.
Use counter to deal 1 damage to any opponent.
Sacrifice Ballista to outlet again.
